annotations.title: List the names currently in one tier

description: Lists the U.S. stocks in the daily-refreshed rated set whose latest rating carries one conviction tier, strongest composite first: Highest Conviction, Favorable, Hold, Unfavorable, or the speculative and flag words Rising Star, Very Promising, Promising, Runner! and Catalyst Watch. Use this when an agent needs candidates by Market Eyes Live tier, for example 'which names are Highest Conviction today' or 'list the Favorable stocks', to build a watchlist or a scan from the tier rather than from a guess. Each row carries the symbol, company, composite score, as-of date and the public rating page; call check_trade or get_stock_rating on a name for its factors, risks and record. Do not use for quotes, price history, or a personal recommendation. Limitations: the daily-refreshed set only (several hundred names, refreshed through the day), so a ticker scored live on demand is not listed; only ratings dated within five days of the newest one in the set are listed, and the older ones are counted as left out; most funds and REITs carry their own labels in the app and are not listed under these words; up to 25 rows per call; the list is rebuilt at most every 30 minutes. Method: https://marketeyeslive.com/how-melany-is-tested.html. Research data, not financial advice; read-only, never places trades.

limit.description: rows to return, strongest first; default 10

tier.description: one of: Highest Conviction, Favorable, Hold, Unfavorable, Rising Star, Very Promising, Promising, Runner!, Catalyst Watch

name: list_rated_by_tier

outputSchema.description: the names whose current rating carries the tier; omitted when the daily list cannot be read, which returns a text message instead

as_of.description: the most recent scoring day in the list

count_in_tier.description: how many current names in the daily set carry this tier (rows may be fewer)

list_size.description: how many names in the daily-refreshed set carry a current rating (dated within five days of as_of)

older_left_out.description: how many names were left out because their latest rating is older than that

tier_meaning.description: what the tier word means, in plain words
